title: PigShip and the Giant Wolf
description: In PigShip and the Giant Wolf, you will help a little piglet save his brothers from the Wolf Army and defeat them. Are you ready for a classic Shoot 'em up? Use the online ranking to compare your best scores with those of friends and players around the world. - Classic arcade with magnificent pixel art. - Enemy-filled levels and huge final bosses. - Online ranking in the Bones Mode. - Level up system.
